findings.limitation: Exact native runner build source was not available at the attempted public URL. No offline tokenizer replica was substituted; measurements use the installed runner itself with synthetic prompt_eval_count parity.
findings.native_defaults: Request options override generation defaults and model parameters. Explicit system message suppresses the stored Mistral system default. Seed does not enter renderPrompt.
findings.no_truncation: Qualification sets truncate=false only in render-only diagnostics. Every measured complete request plus 512 fits 32768, so the normal study request requires no truncation.
findings.render_only: ChatHandler returns _debug_info.rendered_template before Completion; usesOllamaRenderedChat is true for the captured model configurations. The flag was exercised on fabricated inputs first.
findings.stream: Ollama internally streams completion responses and aggregates them when outer stream=false.
findings.tokenization: llamaServerRunner uses its loopback /tokenize endpoint. completionPromptForRequest uses add_special=true; diagnostic parity establishes the BOS behavior on each captured model. parse_special=true preserves native delimiters.
findings.unknown_options: Options.FromMap warns and ignores unknown keys. Mere HTTP acceptance is therefore insufficient; this qualification reads effective runner slot parameters.
